gen-dafont-college-gf-duru-sans: College traces every curve and stem in one unbroken line width, with big counters opening up its tall lowercase. Duru Sans moves smoothly down the page on wide-mouthed small letters.
gen-dafont-college-gf-fresca: Fresca keeps its strokes free of calligraphic thinning, with short ascenders over big bowls and apertures that stay open outward. Paragraphs glide along easily beneath College's sturdy display letters.
gen-dafont-college-gf-funnel-sans: College gives every curve the full weight of its stems. That heft carries display sizes, while Funnel Sans does its best work in text, with consistent strokes and a generously opened e.
gen-dafont-college-gf-gafata: College cuts every line to one depth, with big counters inside its tall letters, so nothing swells or thins. Gafata stays low and wide-eyed underneath, letting College do the shouting.
gen-dafont-college-gf-geist: College gives every curve the full strength of a stem, with big counters inside its tall lowercase. Geist keeps a level beat, its words forming solid blocks.
gen-dafont-college-gf-gidole: College builds every curve with a stem's full strength. Their shared quality is uniform stroke, College loud and tall, Gidole quieter, with scissor-open terminals and a high midline.
gen-dafont-college-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads warm and approachable, its tall x-height filling the line and its s opened wide. College above it is all stem-strong curves and big, open counters.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a clear gap where its c ends, and its small letters rise nearly to capital height. And College, ruler-straight in weight, is the loud one, giving the pair its edge.
gen-dafont-college-gf-heebo: College makes its o equally thick on sides and top. Heebo sits in a tall central band, its curves stopping short instead of closing, so text moves along with ease.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hind-guntur: Modern in feel, Hind Guntur leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with every stroke held to cable-like uniformity. And beneath College, those tall, stamped-metal letterforms carry text along steadily.
